exposure: maternal group B streptococcus (GBS) antibiotic prophylaxis
maternal group B streptococcus (GBS) antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP)
cohort: 2909 mother-child pairs at Taixing People's Hospital in Eastern China, infants born 2018-2019
finding: Maternal group B streptococcus antibiotic prophylaxis (GBS-IAP) was associated with an increased incidence of atopic dermatitis (AD) in children delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: The cohorts showed that preventive GBS-IAP was potentially associated with increased incidence of AD in children delivered vaginally according to logistic regression models before and after covariate-adjusted treatment (OR: 6.719,95% CI: 4.730-9.544,P < 0.001;aOR: 6.562,95% CI: 4.302-10.008, P < 0.001).
